answer: The canyon gate keeps one dye ledger: each batch of pigment is issued once per epoch, and a signal dyed from it carries the batch number to payout. Two signals carrying the same batch number belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both 550,000 POA stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 350,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 900,000 POA, and five fakes cost 4,500,000 POA before any payout clears.
